# E-18 results (generated by src/report.py; do not edit)

## Part A: max/mean on a grid of groups

Controller runs that hit the move cap: 0. Every value is the largest group load over the mean (1.000 is perfect). "worst" is the worst seed; seeds: 10 at N = 1e4 and 1e5, 5 at 1e6, 3 at 1e7. Full table: `static-agg.csv.gz`.

### A1. The threshold: does each slot count keep max/mean <= 1.25 up to 64 groups?

A point is exempt when the hottest partition alone carries more than 1/G of the load (a ceiling for any design). "strict" is the worst max/mean over every non-exempt point with G <= 64 (all N, all seeds); "vs ideal" is the worst max over the key-level floor max(mean, hottest partition) over every point with G <= 64, exempt or not. "first fail" is the smallest G on the grid where some non-exempt point is above 1.25 (grid up to 256; ">256": none).

## Part B: effective writers per resource (SC-10), searched to 1,024 groups

Controller runs that hit the move cap: 0.

### B3. How much the app must split: the split cap c/G, Zipf 0.99

## Part E: how often the slots alone miss the bar at G <= 64

A draw is a slot failure when at some G <= 64 greedy packing of the slots gives max/mean > 1.25 while the hottest partition alone carries at most 1/G (so Q-18 does not excuse it). "split": the app split every partition above 0.5/G first (nothing is excused). Rate in %, with a 95 % Wilson interval; first G: the median smallest failing G among failing draws.
